notes_for_editor: Thin record. The two FFLA Virginia lists agree on name, county, coordinates and gone status. Unresolved: the Forest Lookouts Virginia index lists SOUTH BRUNSWICK and WHITE PLAINS as two separate Brunswick County entries, while FFLA uses one combined name. This may be one tower under two names or two sites; a human should decide before the record is changed. The record's point (36.63089, -77.94192) is about 2 km from Wikipedia's coordinates for the White Plains community (36.64444, -77.95833); that distance is my own calculation. No NHLR or FFLOS entry, build or staffing date, access note or photo was found. The 1928 and 1991 sentences describe the statewide program; no source ties this site to it.
